news.title: Phantom wallet setup: a guide to Solana, swaps and staking

bullets: Define how Phantom wins in a competitive market. Build on our funded user base, crypto infrastructure, and existing trading products to make discovering, funding, and trading…
Own the prediction markets experience end to end, from discovery to payout.
Sweat the design details with our designers. Make trading simpler for someone placing a first prediction and more powerful for someone placing their fiftieth of the day.
Build a team that stays close to traders. Talk to them every week, read support tickets, and dogfood every build. Turn what you learn into roadmap decisions, and make these habits…
